correctness.rationale: The proof explicitly classifies the only possible maximal matchings and characterizes the earliest eligible center via branch-local independent continuous edge arrival times. Exact polynomial integration yields each winner mass; branch-label symmetry yields every labeled matching probability. The no-central family probabilities and counts imply a strict TV lower bound for at least two positive branches. The proof covers zero-leaf branches, one-branch stars, and nonstar trees, without extrapolation. A separate first-edge exact-rational recursion checked 452 profiles, direct permutation enumeration checked 189821 orders; 21840 strict bias inequalities and 289 double-star boundary checks passed.

value.rationale: This natural depth-two tree family has arbitrarily many nonuniform branches and can have exponentially many labeled maximal matchings. A closed product-integral evaluates the complete greedy terminal law without enumerating edge orders. In the all-positive multi-branch family all maximal matchings have the same size, yet the law differs provably and quantitatively from uniform: this is substantial distributional information absent from known size-only methods. The cograph-covered double-star boundary is not counted as a new value contribution.
